back: One type of atom; cannot be broken down chemically.
Compound: chemically bonded, fixed ratio, new properties. Mixture: physically combined, any ratio, separable physically.
Homogeneous: uniform, one phase (solution, air). Heterogeneous: non-uniform (sand + water).
Solid: vibrate in fixed positions. Liquid: close, slide past. Gas: far apart, fast and random.

front: Why is temperature constant during a change of state?
back: Energy goes into overcoming (or forming) attractions, not into kinetic energy.
Proportional to the average kinetic energy of particles. T(K) = θ(°C) + 273.15.
